about: OSRS farm run travel graph. Nodes are patches, teleport landings and transport network points, with real world coordinates. Walk edge weights come from breadth-first search over the RuneLite Shortest Path plugin's collision map (true tile path, not straight line) at running speed of 2 tiles per 0.6s tick plus 3s of doors and clicks; 'tiles' records the path length. Edges marked estimated could not be pathfound (gates or stairs the collision map treats as sealed) and keep a manual weight. An edge with from='*' is a teleport usable anywhere. Agility shortcuts and NPC escorts (mode 'shortcut') come from the same plugin's transport tables.
transport_notes: transport values match the toggle ids in the planner; requires values are quest and diary ids.
